article_content: Fans of The Hobbit trilogy were left outraged this week after learning that some of the films’ most beloved characters would not be attending the world premiere. New Zealand actor John Callen, who plays the dwarf Oin, took to Facebook on Friday to inform fans that he and his fellow local actors would not be attending the London premiere of the third film on December 1. 'Just had the word that Warner Bros. won’t be taking the Kiwi dwarves of The Hobbit to the London premiere because of budget considerations,' Callen wrote. 'Sorry to all...' At least four online petitions have been launched by fans protesting the decision, which means seven of the thirteen dwarf actors — Jed Brophy (Nori), John Callen (Oin), Mark Hadlow (Dori), Peter Hambleton (Glóin), Stephen Hunter (Bombur), William Kircher (Bifur), and Dean O'Gorman (Fili) — will not attend. One fan, Ulrike Pröschild, wrote: 'This is ridiculous. And disappointing. And simply not fair. You are such an important — no, THE MOST IMPORTANT — part of these movies. You, the dwarves, the company. And this is the WORLD premiere of the LAST Middle-earth movie. The end of an era. This makes me so angry!!' Cristina Salvini added: 'Shame on WB! The Company of Thorin Oakenshield must follow him one last time. We want all the Dwarves for the World Premiere in London. The excuse is insulting and ridiculous.' Warner Bros. later announced that the New Zealand dwarf actors would instead fly to the Los Angeles premiere, while actors portraying European dwarves attend London’s. Further backlash emerged over Warner Bros.’s decision to fund a six-day promotional trip to New Zealand for 150 global competition winners, in partnership with Air New Zealand and Tourism New Zealand. Matt Dravitski from Wingnut Films confirmed the revised travel plans to the New Zealand Herald. Many fans dismissed the Los Angeles event as an 'inadequate substitute' for the official world premiere, and petitions adjusted their focus accordingly. Directed by Sir Peter Jackson, The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies will be released on December 11. The first two films in the trilogy, The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey and The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug, earned over $1 billion and $958 million respectively.

article_content: The New York Times Magazine has published a provocative article claiming that Pakistani authorities were fully aware that Osama bin Laden lived for years in Abbottabad — a revelation that, if true, would fundamentally reshape understanding of the 2011 U.S. raid that killed him. Written by veteran journalist Carlotta Gall, the piece draws from her forthcoming book, 'The Wrong Enemy: America in Afghanistan, 2001–2014,' and cites anonymous sources asserting that Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence (ISI) not only knew of bin Laden’s presence but operated a dedicated unit to manage him. Gall’s claims are serious and potentially explosive. Yet they directly contradict the conclusions drawn by author and investigative journalist Peter Bergen, who spent a decade documenting the hunt for bin Laden. In his 2012 book, 'Manhunt,' Bergen interviewed dozens of top U.S. and Pakistani officials — including CIA Director John Brennan, Secretary of State Hillary Clinton, Admiral Mike Mullen, and others — all of whom consistently stated they had no credible evidence that Pakistan’s government or military had any prior knowledge of bin Laden’s whereabouts. Bergen argues that the U.S. considered a joint raid with Pakistan but abandoned the idea precisely because officials feared leaks — an option that would have been unnecessary had Pakistan already known bin Laden was there. He further notes that top Pakistani officials reacted with visible shock when bin Laden was killed, a reaction confirmed by U.S. Ambassador Cameron Munter. Moreover, Bergen highlights that bin Laden went to extraordinary lengths to conceal his identity even from those living in his compound, making large-scale state complicity highly improbable. While Bergen acknowledges that some classified documents recovered during the raid remain undisclosed — and may contain clues — he insists no public evidence supports Gall’s assertion. He calls on the Obama administration to release any relevant materials so the American public can assess the truth for itself. Until then, he maintains that the weight of available testimony and logic strongly suggests Pakistan was as surprised as the world by bin Laden’s presence in Abbottabad.
translated_content: Magasin New York Times ngedetakang cerita sing nggawa klaim yen otoritas Pakistan teka-tikek ngerti yen Osama bin Laden gedhe ing Abbottabad — panggonan sing dadi tempat kematiane sawise digrebek pasukan Navy SEAL AS ing taun 2011. Artikel iki ditulis dening jurnalis senior Carlotta Gall, sing nggawe sumber saka bukune sing bakal keluar, 'The Wrong Enemy: America in Afghanistan, 2001–2014,' lan ngandhut sumber anonim sing nyebut yen ISI (Intelejen Militer Pakistan) ora cuma ngerti keberadaan bin Laden, nanging uga nduwe tim khusus kanggo ngatur eko. Klaim Gall iki serius lan bisa dadi gebyar. Nanging iki langsung nggawang konklusi sing diarani dening penulis lan jurnalis investigasi Peter Bergen, sing wis nggawe riset selama sepuluh taun babagan perburuan bin Laden. Dina bukune 'Manhunt' taun 2012, Bergen wawancarai puluhan pejabat tinggi AS lan Pakistan — kalebu Direktur CIA John Brennan, Menteri Luar Negeri Hillary Clinton, Laksamana Mike Mullen, lan liya-liyane — kabeh padha nyebut yen ora ana bukti kredibel yen pemerintah utawa militer Pakistan ngerti lokasi bin Laden. Bergen nemokake yen AS pernah mertimbangake operasi gabungan karo Pakistan, nanging dibatalke amarga takut bakal bocor — opsi sing ora bakal diperlukne yen Pakistan wis ngerti bin Laden ana ing sana. Bergen uga nyebut yen pejabat tinggi Pakistan reaksi kaget sawise bin Laden dibunuh, reaksi sing dikonfirmasi dening Duta Besar AS Cameron Munter. Uga, Bergen ngajeni yen bin Laden njaga rahasia identitasé malah saka wong-wong sing ngombe ing kompoundé, mewujudake keterlibatan negara sing luwih gede minangka ora masuk akal. Nanging Bergen ngaku yen ana dokumen rahasia sing diambil nalika raid, sing durung dipublikasi — lan bisa dadi petunjuk. Nanging, ora ana bukti publik sing ngukuhi klaim Gall. Bergen nyeru pemerintah Obama kanggo nayatake dokumen sing relevan supaya rakyat AS bisa nggawe penilaiané sorangan. Sawise iku, dia tetep yen bukti lan logika sing ana ngajeni yen Pakistan kaget kaya dunya ing keberadaan bin Laden ing Abbottabad.

article_content: By James Rush. PUBLISHED: 11:22 EST, 13 June 2013. | UPDATED: 12:02 EST, 13 June 2013. A teenager's house party in a quiet Welsh village descended into chaos after more than 150 uninvited guests arrived—spurred by a Facebook post. Annest Lois, 18, had invited only a dozen close friends for drinks at her family’s home while her parents were away on holiday. But the event quickly escalated when details spread online. More than 150 people crowded into the small three-bedroom house and spilled into the streets of Felinheli, near Bangor in Gwynedd. Neighbors reported the main road was completely blocked. Police arrived to restore order, but tensions flared. Officers faced physical resistance: one female officer was punched and kicked, though uninjured, and a patrol car was damaged. CS gas was deployed to disperse the crowd. Annest later admitted: 'It's my fault. I opened the door. We tried to stop so many coming. There were too many people to control. We just wanted about 12.' Her grandmother, Carol Williams, confirmed no major damage occurred: 'Drinks were spilled, but nothing was broken. The police arrived before things got worse.' Annest and guest Pei Junior Chan, 18, described the situation as having 'gone viral.' North Wales Police confirmed six males were arrested. Two were formally charged—one with criminal damage to a police vehicle and one with a public order offense. A 22-year-old received a fixed penalty notice, and an 18-year-old received a caution for public order violations. Police spokesperson Peter Roberts stated: 'This incident followed a Facebook party request. Four males were taken to Caernarfon police station.' Annest has since returned home, apologized to her parents, and promised not to host another party. Her family and neighbors urge caution when using social media to invite guests.

Pesta rumah remaja ing desa tenang Wales menciut dadi kekacauan sawatéh 150 tamu tanpa undangan nyampek—dipicu déning postingan Facebook. Annest Lois, 18, ngundang mung sapanjingan teman dekat kanggé minum ing rumah keluargane sawatéh orang tuane lagi libur. Nanging acara iki cepet banget meledak sawatéh informasié rilis online. Lebih sapanjingan 150 orang ngepung rumah tiga kamar énggak cukup lan nyambung nganggo jalan desa ing Felinheli, ngarep Bangor ing Gwynedd. Tetangga ngaku jalan utama dadi macet. Polisi nyampek kanggé ngembalike ketertiban, nanging ketegangan ngluas. Petugas kena serangan fisik: siji petugas perempuan dipukul lan ditendang, nanging ora luka, lan mobil patroli rusak. Gas CS dipaké kanggé ngusir kerumunan. Annest kemudian ngaku: 'Kesalahanku. Aku mbukak pintu. Kita coba nggawe entek banyak sing dateng. Terlalu banyák orang kanggé dikontrol. Kita cuma pengin sapanjingan 12 orang.' Nenekne, Carol Williams, ngonfirmasi ora ana kerusakan besar: 'Minuman tumpah, tapi ora ana sing rusak. Polisi nyampek sebelum sesuatu parah terjadi.' Annest lan tamu Pei Junior Chan, 18, nggambarke situasi iki wis 'menyebar viral.' Polisi Gwynedd Utara ngonfirmasi enem laki-laki ditangkap. Sajen diadili—siji kanggé kerusakan kriminal marang kendaraan polisi lan siji kanggé pelanggaran ketertiban umum. Siji laki-laki umur 22 taun kena denda tetap, lan siji laki-laki umur 18 taun kena peringatan kanggé pelanggaran ketertiban umum. Annest wis balik menyang rumah, mohon maaf marang orang tuane, lan njanjikan ora bakal ngadhepi pesta liyane. Keluarga lan tetanggaé nyaranake hati-hati nalika nggunakake media sosial kanggé ngundang tamu.

article_content: (CNN) — Fehmi Khairullah, a Syrian-American doctor living in New Jersey, says he hasn't been able to sleep lately. "The humanitarian situation in many parts of Syria has reached its lowest point. It is horrific," said Khairullah, who collects and delivers aid to Syria. As violence escalates in the sanctions-hit country — and, many argue, due to the lack of government cooperation — humanitarian groups have been unable to reach those suffering most. Even the International Committee of the Red Cross and Red Crescent, the only independent international aid agency operating inside Syria, has not reached trapped civilians in devastated areas such as Baba Amr, a neighborhood in Homs. Last weekend, the aid group announced it had begun distributing aid in the city. But Saleh Debaki, its Damascus-based spokesman, said Thursday that supplies are held at nine distribution centers around Homs — none have reached ravaged neighborhoods like Baba Amr. Residents and activists in Baba Amr said Friday they have received no humanitarian aid in over a month. "It’s been 13 days of continuous shelling in our neighborhood," said Abu Omar, reached via satellite internet from a Baba Amr shelter. "We’ve had no electricity, phone service, or running water for weeks. No food or medical supplies either. We are desperate. Only a few homes here have water wells — that’s our only source." Abu Omar, who withheld his real name for safety reasons, said the few dozen people sheltering in Baba Amr bathe once every five days and restrict water use to drinking alone. Khalil Ahmed, another resident, said he hasn’t seen any bread delivered from outside the neighborhood in weeks. "So we gathered whatever flour we could find to bake bread and share at the shelters," Ahmed said. "We have no baby formula. Parents soak bread in water — that’s what infants eat and drink." There is only one medical facility still operating in Baba Amr — located in the basement of a mosque. It relocated after its previous site was shelled in January, killing three medics, according to Mohamed al-Mohamed, one of the few doctors running the makeshift clinic with primitive tools. Back in the U.S., Khairullah says the suffering will only worsen unless aid can reach those most in need. Soon after the Syrian uprising began on March 15, Khairullah and other Syrian-American professionals founded the Syria First Coalition to collect donations and deliver them to affected families. "Given the sanctions, we wanted to avoid legal risks and avoid dealing with government institutions. So we paid influential businessmen inside Syria in U.S. dollars to obtain food, water, blankets, and other essentials," Khairullah said. This worked for only a few months until no businessman dared risk it under regime surveillance. He then turned to financial institutions in Turkey, Jordan, and Lebanon — transferring funds to purchase aid locally, which was then smuggled across the border. But with fewer safe routes and dwindling cash flow, this method has become increasingly difficult. Current sanctions permit transfers to charitable groups in Syria. "But how can we trust government-backed Syrian groups to distribute aid fairly?" Khairullah asked. Some international NGOs, like Humanitarian Relief for Syria, say they rely solely on Syrian charitable organizations to reach civilians. Others — such as Islamic Relief and Zakat Foundation — focus exclusively on refugees in neighboring countries. "The only way to reach us in Homs is through safe passages," said Abu Omar. On the international front, France is reviving a plan first proposed in November to establish secure corridors for aid delivery via land borders, seaports, or airports — all monitored by international observers. But such a plan requires either Syrian government approval or the deployment of armed peacekeepers, potentially needing a U.N. resolution. French Foreign Minister Alain Juppé discussed the proposal with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in Vienna to avoid a potential Russian veto. The two met following Russia’s February 4 veto of a U.N. resolution based on an Arab League proposal, according to Russia’s state-run ITAR-TASS. "We may reach a compromise on a short-term objective," Juppé told reporters. "We’re ready to work in New York on a draft resolution inspired by the Arab League to halt violence and enable humanitarian aid." Lavrov declined to commit, stating more details were needed before agreement, ITAR-TASS reported. Yet many Syrians cling to hope as their plight unfolds on the global stage. "I am hopeful," Khairullah said. "I’m finally sensing change among international and regional powers regarding the suffering in Syria... and it’s about time."
translated_content: (CNN) — Fehmi Khairullah, dokter warga Suriah-Amerika sing ngengingi New Jersey, nyebut dheweke ora bisa tindur saiki. "Sitwasi kemanusiaan ing sawetara wilayah Suriah wis dadi paling parah. Iki kejam," ujar Khairullah, sing ngumpulake lan ngirimake bantuan kanggo Suriah. Sawise kahanan kerep mlebu ing negara sing kena sanksi — lan, sawetara argumen, amarga kurangnya kerja sama pamarintah — kelompok kemanusiaan ora bisa njangkau wong-wong sing paling menderita. Dheweke ICRC (International Committee of the Red Cross and Red Crescent), sawijining agensi internasional independen sing mlayani ing Suriah, uga ora njangkau wong-wong sing terjebak ing wilayah sing rusak kaya kawasan Baba Amr ing kutha Homs. Minggu wingin, kelompok bantuan iki ngumumake wis mulai mbaghi bantuan ing kutha iku. Nanging Saleh Debaki, juru bicarane sing basis ing Damaskus, nyebut Kamis yen bantuan kasebut diwenehakna ing sembilan pusat distribusi ing sekitar Homs — ora ana sing njangkau wilayah sing rusak kaya Baba Amr. Wong-wong lan aktivis ing Baba Amr nyebut Jumat kemarin durung njangkau bantuan kemanusiaan ing luwih saka siji bulan. "Iki wis 13 dina penggempuran terus-menerus ing kawasan kita," ujar Abu Omar, sing dihubungi kanthi internet satelit saka tempat perlindungan Baba Amr. "Kita ora duwe listrik, layanan telepon, utawa air bersih ing minggu-minggu iki. Ora ana makanan utawa obat-obatan. Kita kerep banget! Cuma sawetara omah sing duwe sumur — iku sumber tunggal kita kanggo air!" Abu Omar, sing ora pengin njawab jeneng asline amarga alasan keselamatan, nyebut sawetara puluh wong sing ngrampungake ing tempat perlindungan Baba Amr mandi sawijining wektu lima dina utawa luwih, lan nggawe panggunaan air mung kanggo minum. Khalil Ahmed, wong liyane sing asale saka Baba Amr, nyebut durung ndeleng roti sing dikirim saka luar kawasan iki ing minggu-minggu iki. "Nanging kita ngumpulake tepung sing bisa kita temokake kanggo mbuat roti lan mbaghi-bagi ing tempat perlindungan," ujar Ahmed. "Kita ora duwe susu bayi. Orang tuwa nyobek roti ing air… iku sing digunakake bayi kanggo mangan lan ngombe." Cuma ana sawijining fasilitas kesehatan sing masih mlayani ing Baba Amr — ana ing ruang bawah tanah masjid. Iku dipindahke amarga lokasi pekenne diserang ing Januari, nemtu tiga petugas medis, menurut Mohamed al-Mohamed, sawijining saka sawetara dokter sing ngatur klinik dadakan karo alat-alat primitif. Kembali ing Amerika Serikat, Khairullah nyebut penderitaan bakal makin parah yen ora ana cara kanggo ngirim bantuan kemanusiaan marang wong-wong sing paling butuh. Sawise pemberontakan Suriah mulai ing 15 Maret, Khairullah lan profesional Suriah-Amerika liyane ndirikake Syria First Coalition kanggo ngumpulake sumbangan lan ngirimake marang keluarga sing kena dampak. "Amarga sanksi, kita ora pengin ketemu masalah hukum. Lan kita ora pengin nggawe hubungan karo institusi pamarintah. Nanging kita mbayar pedagang berpengaruh ing Suriah karo dolar AS kanggo mendhem makanan, air, selimut, lan barang-barang kemanusiaan liyane," ujar Khairullah. Iku bisa galih saka sawetara bulan sadurunge ora ana pedagang sing berani njalari iku ing pangawasan rezim. Dheweke mbukak jalur keuangan ing Turki, Yordania, lan Lebanon — ngirim dana kanggo nggawe bantuan lokal, sing banjur diselundupake menyang perbatasan Suriah. Nanging karo kurangé jalur aman lan aliran dana sing mlebu, cara iki makin susah. Sanksi saiki ngijini transfer dana marang kelompok amal ing Suriah. "Nanging gimana kita bisa percaya kelompok amal sing didukung pamarintah kanggo ngatur distribusi bantuan?" ujar Khairullah. Sawetara organisasi kemanusiaan internasional kaya Humanitarian Relief for Syria ngaku mung mriksa lewat organisasi amal Suriah kanggo njangkau wong-wong sing kena dampak. Liyane — kaya Islamic Relief lan Zakat Foundation — mung njangkau para pengungsi Suriah ing negara-negara tetangga. "Cara tunggal kanggo njangkau kita ing Homs yaiku karo nggawe koridor kemanusiaan," ujar Abu Omar. Ing tingkat internasional, Prancis lagi nggawe ulang rencana sing kapisah ing November sing nyoba nggawe iku — nggawe akses aman kanggo organisasi bantuan kanggo ngirim bantuan menyang populasi sing kena dampak lewat rute darat, pelabuhan laut, utawa bandara — kabeh diawasi dening pengamat internasional. Nanging rencana kasebut butuh persetujuan pamarintah Suriah utawa dukungan penjaga perdamaian bersenjata. Ing kasus belakang, butuh resolusi PBB. Menteri Luar Negeri Prancis Alain Juppé ngobrol rencanane "koridor kemanusiaan" karo rekan Rusiane, Sergei Lavrov, kanggo nggagalkan veto ing resolusi PBB. Keduane nemu ing Wina kanggo njupuk kompromi, sawise Rusia veto resolusi PBB sing didhukung Liga Arab ing 4 Februari, menurut ITAR-TASS milik pamarintah Rusia. "Kita bisa njupuk kompromi ing tujuan jangka pendek," ujar Juppé marang wartawan. "Kita siap kerja ing New York kanggo nggawe rancangan resolusi sing diilhami Liga Arab kanggo ngenteni kekerasan lan nyediakake bantuan kemanusiaan." Lavrov ora nyatakake komitmennya lan nyebut butuh rincian luwih lengkap sadurunge setuju, menurut ITAR-TASS. Nanging sawetara wong Suriah tetep ngandharake harapan nalika penderitaan mereka dibahas ing panggung internasional. "Aku seneng," ujar Khairullah. "Aku asring nyenengi perubahan ing antarane kuasa internasional lan regional nggeni penderitaan ing Suriah... lan saiki sajroning waktune!"

article_content: Liverpool are monitoring Real Madrid stars Karim Benzema and Isco but are committed to preserving squad harmony and will not pursue moves that disrupt team chemistry. Manager Brendan Rodgers is finalizing signings for Loic Remy and Dejan Lovren, while Divock Origi will return to Lille on loan. Benzema is close to agreeing a new contract with Real Madrid, who are seeking a new striker following Alvaro Morata’s move to Juventus. A potential transfer to Liverpool would cost approximately £40 million with weekly wages of £200,000 — a significant investment aimed at replacing the star power lost with Luis Suarez’s departure. However, the deal remains complex due to financial and logistical challenges. Isco, meanwhile, faces reduced playing time with the arrival of James Rodriguez. While he remains loyal to Madrid, a temporary loan move before the window closes could be explored. Real Madrid are also discussing a loan move for Angel di Maria to Paris Saint-Germain, with a permanent transfer planned for next summer to align with Financial Fair Play rules. Tiago Mendes’ proposed free transfer to Chelsea has stalled due to third-party ownership complications: his agent, Jorge Mendes, retains an economic stake in the player, which violates UK regulations. Valencia has made an offer, and Atletico Madrid have renewed their own one-year contract proposal worth £2 million annually. Barcelona legend Xavi is preparing to announce his move to New York City FC, the MLS franchise owned by Manchester City. He will follow David Villa and Frank Lampard to the U.S., though his exact timeline remains unclear. With lingering Achilles issues, Xavi is expected to rest before joining preseason training in March. Final details — including transfer fee and a farewell testimonial — are being negotiated. Swansea City’s Wilfried Bony is attracting interest from Everton, Tottenham, and Qatari side Lekhwiya. However, Swansea’s £25 million asking price and Bony’s high wage demands have cooled talks. Lekhwiya’s manager, Michael Laudrup, is keen to sign him after missing out on Michu. Tottenham are keeping tabs on PSV Eindhoven’s Memphis Depay but are currently focused on securing Morgan Schneiderlin from Southampton. They’ve also shown interest in Hajduk Split’s Nikola Vlasic, though only Roma has made an offer — and it falls short of the £6 million asking price. Leicester City continue to monitor Sebastian Blanco, the Metalist Kharkiv attacking midfielder, who has refused to return to Ukraine following the MH17 tragedy. Blanco, currently based in Buenos Aires, stated he ‘does not feel safe’ returning to Kharkiv. Leicester, who previously pursued him this summer, believe he could be available for around £2 million — a significant discount from his market value. Watford have submitted a £1.2 million bid for Leicester’s Andy King and expect competition for captain Troy Deeney, with QPR, Burnley, and Swansea also interested. Chelsea’s 19-year-old midfielder Lewis Baker, who captained the U21s and made his senior debut last season, is attracting attention from Championship clubs including Bolton, Birmingham, and Middlesbrough. A loan move is seen as vital for his development amid intense midfield competition. Burnley are increasing their bid for West Brom’s Craig Dawson to around £3 million. The 24-year-old center-back is eager to reunite with manager Sean Dyche. Burnley are also interested in loaning Chelsea’s 19-year-old Nathaniel Chalobah. Joe Thompson, who recently recovered from non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma, made a comeback appearance for Bury in a friendly. Having been released by Tranmere Rovers, he is now seeking a new club to revive his career. Charlton Athletic have completed the signing of West Ham goalkeeper Stephen Henderson on a three-year contract. He becomes manager Bob Peeters’ eighth summer acquisition, joining Yoni Buyens, Igor Vetokele, Andre Bikey, Franck Moussa, Tal Ben Haim, Johann Berg Gudmundsson, and George Tucudean.

Manajer Brendan Rodgers lagi nyiapaké pindahé Loic Remy lan Dejan Lovren, sakaligus Divock Origi bakal balik menyang Lille kanthi pinjam. Benzema lagi ngarep-arep nglengkapi kontrak anyar karo Real Madrid, sing lagi nyari penyerang anyar sawise Morata pindah menyang Juventus. Nanging diajak tetep setia marang Madrid, pinjam sementara bisa dipertimbangaké sawise jendela pindah tutup. Real Madrid uga lagi ngobrol babagan pinjam Angel di Maria menyang Paris Saint-Germain, karo pindah permanen direncanaké taun depan kanggo nyampekake aturan FFP. Pindah gratis Tiago Mendes menyang Chelsea wis mandeg amarga masalah kepemilikan pihak ketiga: agené, Jorge Mendes, tetep duwe saham ekonomis ing pemain, sing melanggar regulasi Inggris. Valencia wis nawarkan tawaran, lan Atletico Madrid wis nawarkan kontrak anyar siji taun senilai £2 juta/tahun. Nanging harga £25 juta lan tuntutan gaji gedhe Bony mbuwang minat. Pelatih Lekhwiya, Michael Laudrup, seneng nyerapé dheweke sawise gagal nyerap Michu. Dheweke uga minat marang Nikola Vlasic saka Hajduk Split, nanging mung Roma sing nuduhaké tawaran — lan iku kurang saka harga £6 juta. Blanco, sing saiki ana ing Buenos Aires, ngomong dheweke 'ora ngerasa aman' balik menyang Kharkiv. article_content: Liverpool are moving swiftly to secure the signature of 19-year-old Belgian forward Divock Origi, hoping to beat off competition from Tottenham and Arsenal. The Reds have been closely monitoring Origi throughout the season and are prepared to submit a £6 million offer for the Lille striker. However, instead of immediately bringing him to Anfield, Liverpool plan to loan him back to Lille for another year to continue his growth. Origi, who was born in Ostend on April 18, 1995, has already caught attention at the 2014 World Cup — scoring Belgium’s opener against Russia and earning widespread acclaim for his performances. Though he’s openly spoken about his childhood dream of playing in the Premier League, the young talent is keeping his feet on the ground, prioritizing Belgium’s campaign in Brazil. In an interview with the Express, he said: 'As a little boy, I always dreamed of playing in the Premier League, but right now, I’m focused on helping my team. My advisors and Lille will decide my next steps after the tournament.' With 40 senior appearances and six goals for Lille, plus four caps for Belgium, Origi is seen as a promising prospect — and Liverpool believe this patient approach gives them the edge over rivals eager to snap him up now.

article_content: While fitness trackers monitor steps, weight, and calories, Quitbit turns health tracking upside down — it tracks how many cigarettes you smoke. Designed not to encourage smoking, but to gently raise awareness and motivate change, this smart lighter reveals the true scale of your habit. Created by Boston-based designers Ata Ghofrani and Kuji Nakano, Quitbit looks like a classic Zippo lighter. Each time it’s used, a small LED display updates to show how many cigarettes have been smoked today and how long it’s been since the last one. Powered by a rechargeable lithium polymer battery that lasts a week (or one pack per day), it connects via Bluetooth Low Energy to iOS 5+ and Android 4.3+ devices. A companion app tracks long-term trends, calculates money saved by cutting back, and identifies peak smoking times throughout the day. Users can share progress with friends on Facebook or Twitter, or join Quitbit’s online community for support. Unlike regular lighters, Quitbit uses a heating element — similar to car cigarette lighters — to ignite cigarettes. Crucially, it’s engineered to only count smokes initiated by the registered user. Flicking the lighter without lighting a cigarette, or lending it to a friend, won’t affect the count — though the exact mechanism remains undisclosed. Users can also program timed restrictions via the app to limit smoking during certain hours, helping reduce daily intake gradually. Launched on Kickstarter with a $50,000 goal, Quitbit has raised over $10,300 as of now. Early backers can secure one for $79 (£46); the retail price will be $149 (£88) when it launches in June. Weighing just 72 grams and measuring 67 x 43 x 10 mm, it’s compact enough to fit in a pocket.

Ngguyur lighter tanpa ngobarkan rokok, utawa ngasilke karo teman, ora bakal ngaruhi penghitungan — meskipun mekanisme pastine durung dijelasake. Pangguna uga bisa ngatur pembatasan wektu ngluwuri aplikasi kanggo ngemot ngerokok ing wektu-waktu tertentu, mboten ngajak pengurangan konsumsi harian. Diluncurake ing Kickstarter karo tujuan $50.000, Quitbit wis ngumpulake luwih saka $10.300 saiki. Pendukung awal bisa entuk sawijining kanggo $79 (£46); harga eceran bakal $149 (£88) nalika diluncurake ing Juni. Mbangun 72 gram lan ukuran 67 x 43 x 10 mm, luwih gampang dimasukke saku.

article_content: Code embedded in iOS 8 suggests Apple’s upcoming iPhone 6 may include a built-in barometer to measure air pressure, altitude, and local weather conditions. Such a sensor could enable real-time environmental tracking, benefiting outdoor enthusiasts like mountain climbers, runners, and cyclists. Beyond environmental sensing, the barometer would improve the speed and precision of the phone’s location services by reducing the computational load required for GPS positioning using altitude data. The discovery was made by FutureTap developer Ortwin Gentz, who identified dedicated 'altitude tracking' frameworks in the iOS 8 codebase. Testing on an iPhone 5S failed, indicating the software is designed for a future device. Rumors further suggest the iPhone 6 will feature larger displays — a 4.7-inch model and a larger 5.5-inch variant — replacing the current 4-inch screens. Design changes reportedly include a slimmer profile, rounded edges, and a relocated power button. Camera upgrades are anticipated, with reports initially predicting a 10-megapixel sensor, but the final product shipped with an 8MP iSight camera featuring improved optics and image processing. Apple is expected to adopt in-cell touch technology to minimize thickness, though production challenges with larger displays may delay the 5.5-inch model. Leaked images, allegedly from Foxconn insiders and shared on Weibo, depict a rounded body with a protruding camera lens, aligning with other design rumors. While Deutsche Telekom reportedly informed customers of a September 19 launch date, Apple officially launched the iPhone 6 on September 9, 2014 — indicating the earlier date was inaccurate. Apple’s CEO Tim Cook has hinted only at 'new product categories' for 2014, leaving room for speculation about the Apple Watch and updated iPads, which may also incorporate similar sensors. Similar barometric and humidity sensors have already been used in Samsung’s Galaxy S4 and S5, suggesting Apple is catching up rather than innovating in this area.

Luwih saka pelacakan lingkungan, barometer bakal nggenahake kecepatan lan presisi layanan lokasi ponsel kanthi ngurangi beban komputasi sing diperlukan kanggo posisi GPS nggunakake data ketinggian. Temuan iki dilakokake dening pengembang FutureTap Ortwin Gentz, sing ngidentifikasi kerangka kerja 'pelacakan ketinggian' sing khusus ing basis kode iOS 8. Pengujian ing iPhone 5S gagal, nandhakake software iki dirancang kanggo perangkat anyar. Desas-desus liyane nandhakake iPhone 6 bakal duwe layar luwih gedhe — versi 4,7 inci lan versi 5,5 inci — ngganti layar 4 inci saiki. Perubahan desain kabeh dilaporake kalebu profil sing lebih tipis, tepi sing melingkar, lan tombol daya sing dipindhah. Apple diantisipasi bakal nggunakake teknologi sentuh in-cell kanggo ngurangi ketebalan, nanging tantangan produksi karo tampilan gedhe bisa mbatesi versi 5,5 inci. Gambar bocor, sing dituhake dening insider Foxconn lan dibagike ing Weibo, nuduhake desain melingkar karo lensa kamera sing ngluwihi, nyepadhi desas-desus liyane. Miturut Deutsche Telekom, pelanggan diinformasikan tanggal peluncuran 19 September, nanging Apple resmi meluncurake iPhone 6 ing 9 September 2014 — nandhakake tanggal sadurunge salah. CEO Apple Tim Cook wis nggadahi cuma 'kategori produk anyar' kanggen 2014, ngluwehi spesulasi ngenani Apple Watch lan iPad anyar, sing uga kerep nggabungake sensor kaya ngono. Sensor barometrik lan kelembaban mirip wis dianggo ing Samsung Galaxy S4 lan S5, nandhakake Apple lagi ngejar ketertinggalan tinimbang inovasi ing bidang iki.

article_content: Despite its appearance straight out of a science fiction film, this striking landscape is a natural sulphur spring located in Dallol, Ethiopia. Its vibrant yellows and deep browns create an alien-like terrain — not from extraterrestrial life, but from exceptionally high concentrations of salt and minerals. Towering mounds of solid salt rise nearly as high as the surrounding earth, forming an eerie, dreamlike scenery. New Zealand-based photographer Bradley Ambrose braved scorching temperatures reaching up to 53°C to capture these otherworldly vistas in the Afar region. 'Experiencing Dallol is like stepping onto another planet,' he said. Like a journey into space, the environment is dangerously hostile: thin crusts of ground risk collapsing into boiling acidic waters, while the air reeks of rotten eggs from sulphur emissions. Ambrose, originally from Rotorua — a region known for its own geothermal springs — was still stunned by Dallol’s intensity. 'Due to its high salt levels and unique mineral composition, Dallol was an incredibly concentrated zone of micro-activity, far brighter and more varied than anything I’ve ever seen,' he noted. The area lies below sea level and was once submerged under ancient seas, explaining its extreme salinity. Locals warned him that the 'lakes' he crossed en route were composed of salt layers thousands of meters deep. He recalled, 'I thought I might break through the ground and boil alive.' Yet amid the peril, he found breathtaking beauty. 'There was so much color and wonder — I wasn’t sure I could capture it all in photographs.'

Gunung-gunung garam padhet naik setinggi tumpukan tanah ing ngarepé, nggawe pemandangan sing aneh lan mimpi. Fotografer asal Selandia Baru, Bradley Ambrose, ngalahaké suhu panas sing njeblok nganti 53 derajad Celsius kanggo mburu pemandangan aliené ing wilayah Afar. 'Mbangun ing Dallol kaya nyuwun saka planet liyané,' ujare. Kaya perjalanan nang antariksa, lingkungané ngancam: kulit tanah sing tipis bisa runtuh menyang air asam sing mendidih, nanging udharaé bau kaya telur busuk saka emisi sulphur. Ambrose, sing asale saka Rotorua — wilayah sing dikenal karo sumber geotermalé dhewe — tetep kaget dening intensitas Dallol. 'Amarga konsentrasi garam lan komposisi mineralé, Dallol yaiku zona mikro-aktivitas sing sangat padhet, luwih terang lan luwih varied tinimbang sing pernah aku delok,' ujare. Wilayah iki ana ing ngisor permukaan laut lan dhisiké dienggo ngelingi laut purba, menehi penjelasan kanggo salinitasé sing ekstrim. Warga lokal nggawe peringatan yen 'danau-danau' sing katon nalika ngayuh kudu lewati yaiku lapisan garam ratusan meter tekané. 'Aku kira bakal tembus tanahé lan digodhog mati,' ujare. Nanging ing tengah-tengah bahaya, ana keindahan sing luar biasa. 'Ana warna lan keajaiban sing banget — aku ora yakin bisa nyawangé kabehé ing foto.'

article_content: Fast-food giant McDonald’s has apologized for a recent advertisement that mocked the severe haze pollution blanketing Singapore. The ad playfully repurposed the acronym PSI—normally standing for Pollutant Standards Index—to promote a new line of dipping sauces with the tagline: 'Today’s Peak Sauce Index is looking deliciously high.' The advertisement was published in local newspapers during one of the worst episodes of air pollution in Singapore’s history, sparking widespread public backlash. Many residents expressed outrage, feeling the campaign trivialized a serious public health crisis. A McDonald’s spokesperson stated the ad was 'not intended to trivialize' the haze situation and claimed it was designed and scheduled before conditions deteriorated. However, they acknowledged that publishing it amid record-breaking pollution levels made the campaign 'inappropriate.' 'We are truly sorry that it caused distress,' the spokesperson said. 'We share the concerns of Singaporeans and were equally surprised by how severely PSI levels spiked.' One frustrated customer commented on McDonald’s Singapore’s Facebook page: 'Not funny, McDonald’s.' Others argued that Singaporeans should maintain a sense of humor even during difficult times. The PSI level in Singapore dropped to its lowest point in two weeks, thanks to favorable wind patterns. On June 23, the index reached a record-high 401—classified as 'hazardous'—surpassing previous peaks of 371 and 321. Readings above 200 are considered hazardous to health. Illegal slash-and-burn agricultural fires in Sumatra have been identified as the primary source of the transboundary haze. The pollution has forced hundreds of schools to close in Malaysia and Indonesia, while hospitals in affected regions reported over a 100% surge in asthma, respiratory illnesses, and conjunctivitis cases. Singapore’s Environment Minister, Vivian Balakrishnan, urged Indonesia to take 'urgent and definitive action' to stop the fires at their source. He wrote on Facebook: 'This is now the worst haze Singapore has ever faced. No country or corporation has the right to pollute the air at the expense of Singaporeans’ health and well-being.'

article_content: At approximately 2:50 a.m. Monday, a fire erupted in the aft mooring area of Royal Caribbean’s Grandeur of the Seas cruise ship as it sailed toward the Bahamas. An intercom alert woke passengers, instructing them to don life jackets and proceed to the nearest deck. Danielle Miller, one of the 2,224 guests aboard, recalled waking her roommate in alarm, unsure of the cause—initially fearing the ship was sinking due to a prior storm. Though the ship remained fully powered—with intact propulsion and communications—it was rerouted to Freeport, Bahamas, instead of its planned destination, CocoCay. Firefighters extinguished the blaze by 5 a.m., after it had spread to the fourth deck near the crew lounge. No lives were lost. Miller described the scene on deck as chaotic but orderly: passengers in orange life jackets, some crying, others silent with fear. Two guests required medical attention for fainting; others were treated for elevated blood pressure and a sprained ankle. Royal Caribbean confirmed all passengers and 796 crew members were accounted for. By Monday afternoon, the company announced the cancellation of the remainder of the seven-night cruise. Passengers were offered full refunds and vouchers for future sailings. Flights were arranged to return travelers to Baltimore, where the voyage originated. The first flight departed Tuesday morning. Video footage recorded by Miller and her friend Katie Coleman showed passengers calmly listening to crew instructions under the night sky. 'We’re on deck right now, 3 a.m., in our life jackets. Not a drill, not a joke,' the narration reads. Royal Caribbean’s President and CEO Adam Goldstein traveled to Freeport to meet passengers personally. The U.S. Coast Guard, along with Bahamian officials and the National Transportation Safety Board, are conducting a joint investigation into the fire’s origin. The cause remains unknown. Miller praised the crew’s training and composure: 'They tried their best to make everyone comfortable. I felt confident we’d be okay.' The Grandeur of the Seas, launched in 1996 and refurbished in 2012, is one of many ships recently affected by safety incidents—including the 2012 Costa Concordia sinking and the 2013 Carnival Triumph engine fire.

Nanging kapi tetep mawa daya—propulsi lan komunikasi tetep normal—kapi diarani neng Freeport, Bahama, alih-alih tujuan asliné, CocoCay. Api dipadamake jam 5 a.m., sawise mbabar nganggo dek papat neng omah awak. Ora ana sing mati. Miller njelaske pemandangan ing dek kaya kacau tapi tertib: penumpang neng jubah oranye, sawetara nangis, liyané gumun. Sawetara penumpang kudu kena pengobatan amarga pingsan; liyané diobati amarga tekanan darah dhuwur lan keseleo. Royal Caribbean ngonfirmasi kabeh penumpang lan 796 kru padha diakui. Pada Senen sore, perusahaan ngumumake pembatalan sisih saka pelayaran pitung dina. Penumpang diajak refund purna lan voucher kanggo pelayaran sadina. Penerbangan disiapake kanggo ngembaliake penumpang neng Baltimore, tempat pelayaran asline. Penerbangan pertama lepas Selasa dina. Rekaman video sing direkam dening Miller lan temané Katie Coleman nuduhake penumpang enteng mlayani intruksi kru ing ngendi bengi. 'Kita neng dek saiki, jam 3 a.m., neng jubah keselamatan. Ora latihan, ora joke,' jelas narator. Presiden lan CEO Royal Caribbean Adam Goldstein mlaku neng Freeport kanggo nemu penumpang. U.S. Coast Guard, lan pejabat Bahama lan National Transportation Safety Board lagi nggawe investigasi gabungan ngenani asal usul api. Penyebabé durung diketahui. Miller ngapresiasi pelatihan lan ketenangan kru: 'Mereka nyoba kanggo nggawe kabeh orang enteng. Aku yakin kita bakal aman.' Kapi Grandeur of the Seas, diluncuraké taun 1996 lan direnovasi taun 2012, yaiku salah siji saka kapi-kapi sing wis kena insiden keselamatan—termasuk kecelakaan Costa Concordia taun 2012 lan kebakaran mesin Carnival Triumph taun 2013.

article_content: In Cambodia, a tragic loss has deepened fears over the spread of bird flu. A 2-year-old girl from Prey Veng province died on Monday after contracting the H5N1 strain — the country’s third human fatality this year. Just days earlier, a 50-year-old man in nearby Svay Rieng province succumbed to the same virus. The first case of 2024 occurred in February, when an 11-year-old girl died; her father, though infected, recovered. Globally, the H5N1 virus has been circulating in birds since 2003, spreading from Asia across Europe, Africa, and even the Americas since 2021. According to the World Health Organization, nearly 900 human cases have been recorded worldwide, with over half proving fatal. Cambodia alone has seen 58 cases since the outbreak began. The U.S. CDC notes that more than 21,000 poultry outbreaks have occurred between 2013 and 2022, signaling a sharp uptick in animal infections. While human cases remain rare, scientists are alarmed: as the virus mutates in animals closely interacting with people, the risk of a strain capable of human-to-human transmission grows. The little girl’s mother, 22-year-old Chhuon Srey Mao, spoke to AP from their village, Chhmar Lort. Her daughter fell ill on October 1 with fever, cough, and vomiting. After five days of local treatment, her condition deteriorated, prompting a trip to Phnom Penh’s children’s hospital — where she passed away. Mao said several chickens in the village, including four from her own flock, had died in late September. She disposed of them without cooking or handling them, insisting her daughter never came into contact with the birds. Still, she suspects the child picked up the virus while playing in the yard where the infected chickens once roamed. Health workers have since sprayed disinfectant around her home and neighboring houses, urging residents to report any illness immediately. Fortunately, the rest of Mao’s family remains healthy — but her fear lingers.

Kasus pertama ing 2024 terjadi ing Februari, nanging gadis umur 11 taun iku wafat; bapake, meskipun kena, bisa selamat. Secara global, virus H5N1 wis edhedhed ing populasi burung saka 2003, ngluas nganti Eropah, Afrika, lan malah Amerika Kidul since 2021. Menurut Organisasi Kesehatan Dunia, nyaris 900 kasus manusia wis dilaporake ing saben jero, karo lebihi setengahé fatal. Kamboja wangsul 58 kasus saka awal wabah. CDC Amerika Serikat nyebutake yen luwih saka 21.000 wabah ayam wis terjadi antarane 2013 lan 2022, nandhakake peningkatan tajam ing infeksi hewan. Nanging kasus manusia tetep langka, para ilmuwan ngresiki: nalika virus iki mutasi ing hewan sing duwe kontak erat karo manusia, risiko ana strain sing bisa nular antar-manusia munggah. Ibu saking gadis cilik iku, Chhuon Srey Mao (22 taun), ngomong marang AP saking desane, Chhmar Lort. Putrane kêna sakit dina 1 Oktober karo gejala demam, batuk, lan muntah. Dheweke nyiep ayam-ayam sing mati tanpa dimasak utawa disentuh, nanging njamin putrane ora pernah nyentuh burung-burung iku. Petugas kesehatan wis nyemprot disinfektan ing omahé lan omah-omah liyane, ngajak warga kanggo ngabari yen ana sing kêna sakit. Apiké, anggota keluarga liyane saking Mao tetep sehat — nanging rasa khawatiré tetep ana.

article_content: A woman called 999 to report that her ice cream lacked sufficient chocolate sprinkles. She told the operator: 'It doesn’t seem like much of an emergency—but it is.' West Midlands Police released the audio recording, calling the call 'unbelievable,' noting that someone in genuine danger might have been unable to reach emergency services. The caller was arguing with the ice cream van owner over uneven sprinkles and refused to accept the product without a refund. During the one-minute call, she explained: 'He’s put the sprinkles on one side and none on the other. I asked him to fix it—he refused. I asked for my money back—he refused.' The operator responded: 'This isn’t a police matter—it’s a civil issue.' The caller persisted, asking how to resolve it. She was advised to contact Citizens Advice or Trading Standards. When she asked how to reach them, the operator replied: 'Try the internet. This is a 999 emergency line for life-or-death situations.' The call ended shortly after. This incident is among several recent non-emergency calls to West Midlands Police, including reports of a rat in a kitchen, a complaint about a sex worker’s appearance, a forgotten Facebook password, and even a request to 'frighten' a sibling. In response, Chief Superintendent Jim Andronov warned that every wasted minute on 999 could delay help to someone truly in peril. He emphasized: '999 is for emergencies only—when a crime is in progress, someone’s life is in danger, or violence is occurring or threatened.'

article_content: Maria Bacon, a 30-year-old single mom from Dublin, once felt trapped in a cycle of low self-worth and weight gain after giving birth. Before becoming a mother, she was a size 10—energetic, confident, and socially active. But after her son arrived, post-natal depression took hold. With no partner to share the load, she felt alone, exhausted, and overwhelmed. Instead of balanced meals, she turned to snacks—chips, chocolate, takeaways—skipping breakfast and lunch entirely. Over time, her weight ballooned to 13 stone 7 pounds (size 20), and she hid behind oversized tracksuits, avoiding mirrors and social events. She couldn’t keep up with her growing son during playtime, which deepened her guilt. Dating? Out of the question. Shopping? Impossible—none of her favorite stores carried her size. Even her close-knit family noticed the change: the vibrant woman they knew had faded into someone withdrawn and defeated. She tried countless diets, but each failure left her more discouraged. Exercise seemed impossible—she had no energy, and the thought of starting again felt crushing. Then came the Vi Challenge. Unlike other programs, its 90-day plan felt sustainable—not restrictive, but realistic. She set a goal: return to her pre-baby weight of 10 stone. Today, she’s at 10 stone 7 pounds, having shed nearly 3 stone. More than the number on the scale, she’s reclaimed her life. She now chases her son through the park, walks beside him on his bike, and even returned to the gym. Two years ago, a pretty dress sat untouched in her closet; this past Christmas, she slipped it on. Her son looked up and said, 'Mum, you look like an angel.' That moment, she says, changed everything. Confidence, energy, joy—they’re all back.

article_content: After lifting the FA Cup and Community Shield, Arsenal’s squad is buzzing with renewed ambition — this could finally be the year they challenge for the Premier League title. Striker Olivier Giroud made it clear: winning the league is the goal. Last season’s mid-year slump won’t define them again. With the return of World Cup winners Mesut Özil, Lukas Podolski, and Per Mertesacker, the team feels deeper and more dangerous. While Wenger is cautious about rushing them back, Mertesacker might feature against Crystal Palace due to a thin center-back pool. Laurent Koscielny is recovering from a minor Achilles issue and aims to return soon. Up front, Arsenal now boasts an embarrassment of riches: Alexis Sánchez, signed for £32 million from Barcelona, brings electrifying speed and skill. Yaya Sanogo is expected to grow in his second season, and Joel Campbell returns from loan spells with fresh energy. Giroud praised Sánchez’s chemistry in training, comparing it to the seamless integration of Özil. ‘He’s different from us — quicker, more technical, deadly in front of goal,’ Giroud said. ‘He’ll need time to adjust, but he’s world-class.’ Goalkeeper Wojciech Szczesny echoed the confidence, calling this potentially the strongest squad he’s ever been part of. Though they lost Bacary Sagna to Manchester City on a free transfer, they’ve filled the gap with Mathieu Debuchy. With tough early fixtures against Palace, Everton, City, and Spurs, plus a Champions League qualifier against Besiktas looming, the pressure is on — but so is the belief.

Di depan, Arsenal kini punya banyak pilihan: Alexis Sánchez, yang dibeli seharga £32 juta dari Barcelona, membawa kecepatan dan keterampilan memukau. Yaya Sanogo diharapkan berkembang di musim keduanya, dan Joel Campbell kembali setelah masa pinjaman. Giroud memuji kimia Sánchez dalam latihan, membandingkannya dengan integrasi mulus Özil. ‘Dia berbeda dari kami — lebih cepat, lebih teknis, mematikan di depan gawang,’ kata Giroud. ‘Dia butuh waktu untuk beradaptasi, tapi dia pemain luar biasa.’ Kiper Wojciech Szczesny turut menguatkan optimisme itu, menyebut ini kemungkinan skuad terkuat yang pernah ia alami. article_content: In 2009, New York City shattered its own record — not for chaos, but for safety. For the first time since detailed tracking began in 1963, the city recorded its lowest number of murders: just 461. That’s an 11% drop from the previous year, and part of a broader, decades-long trend of falling crime. Mayor Michael Bloomberg, standing beside Police Commissioner Ray Kelly at the graduation of 250 new officers, declared the year a turning point. He pointed to smart policing: using real-time data to guide patrols, investing in resources, and targeting hotspots through Operation Impact — a program that since 2003 has flooded dangerous neighborhoods with both seasoned and rookie cops. The results? Murders have plummeted more than 80% since their 1990 peak of over 2,200. Major crimes like rape and robbery have dropped by nearly a third, and for 19 straight years, serious offenses have kept going down. Even nationally, violence is easing: the FBI reported a 10% drop in U.S. murders during the first half of 2009. As the newest members of the world’s largest police force head out for their first shift — patrolling Times Square on New Year’s Eve — the message is clear: safety isn’t luck. It’s strategy, persistence, and people showing up.

Walikota Michael Bloomberg, nggawa Komisaris Polisi Ray Kelly ing upacara kelulusan 250 petugas anyar, nyebut taun iki minangka titik balik. Dheweke ngajeni polisi cerdas: nggunakake data real-time kanggo ngarahake patroli, investasi sumber daya, lan ngtargetke lokasi panas lewat Operation Impact — program sing wis digawe sakmenyang 2003 kanggo ngirim tim petugas anyar lan berpengalaman menyang wilayah-wilayah berbahaya. Krimi utama kaya pemerkosaan lan pencurian ilang nyaris sepertiga, lan kanggo 19 taun kerep, krimi serius terus turun. Sapadha petugas anyar saka pasukan polisi paling gedhe ing dunya mlaku menyang tugas pisanané — nglintasi Times Square ing Tahun Anyar — pesané jelas: keselamatan iku ora kebetulan. Iku strategi, keteguhan, lan wong-wong sing njaga.

article_content: Personal drones emerged as one of the most sought-after Christmas gifts this year—but many new owners are quickly learning how challenging it can be to fly them safely. Since Christmas, social media has been flooded with stories of drones stuck in trees, lost in the wild, damaged in crashes, or even causing minor injuries. According to the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), drone-related incidents rose steadily throughout 2014—and experts predict the trend will accelerate in the coming months. Flying a drone—often equipped with a camera and controlled via smartphone or remote—is not as simple as it looks. Experts say it takes time and patience to master. Adam Gibson, CEO of Ctrl.Me and a trainer for beginner drone pilots, recommends dedicating about 20 hours per week for two weeks to become proficient. 'You need to not only learn how to pilot the device but also configure it correctly,' he explained. 'Many crashes happen because the compass isn’t calibrated—or worse, someone painted the drone, interfering with its GPS signal.' Demand has surged: Last year, Best Buy carried just one drone model. This year, it offers 13—including eight in-store and five online. BHPhoto.com lists over 140 models priced from $50.99 to $6,500. Amazon sells roughly 10,000 drones monthly, with DJI’s Phantom 2 Vision+ ($1,000) and Parrot’s MiniDrone Rolling Spider ($160) among top sellers. Safety concerns are mounting. In October, a drone carrying a banner sparked a brawl at a soccer match in Belgrade. In December, a drone nearly collided with a commercial airliner at London’s Heathrow Airport. An Oregon man pleaded guilty to flying a drone over bison in Yellowstone’s Midway Geyser Basin—a clear violation of federal park rules. Major manufacturers like DJI, Parrot, and 3D Robotics have responded by building in safety features: automatic altitude limits (capped at 400 feet, far below technical capability), geofencing to block flight near airports, and fail-safes to prevent unauthorized use. They’ve also joined forces with the FAA and hobbyist groups to launch a nationwide safety initiative, including the website knowbeforeyoufly.com, safety pamphlets, and instructional inserts in every box. 'No matter how small the drone, always be aware of your surroundings,' urged Lisa Ellman, former White House advisor. 'And don’t use it to spy on your neighbors.'

Sawise Natal, sosial media kacan kaping kanyangin kajadian drone sané nyangkut ing pohon, ilang, rusak, utawi malah nyebabke luka ringan. Sajenipun Federal Aviation Administration (FAA), kajadian sané kaitan kaliyan drone wiwit munggah sawise taun 2014—lan para ahli ngedahaken kacan kalah saged munggah sajeroning bulan-bulan sané kacan. Nggawe drone—sané kadang kacan kamera lan diatur dening ponsel utawa kendali—ora semudah sané disangka. Para ahli nyebut yen kacan kalah ngajeni wektu lan kesabaran. Adam Gibson, CEO Ctrl.Me lan trainer drone pemula, nyaranke ngalokasike 20 jam tiap minggu selama dua minggu supaya bisa mahir. 'Kamu kacan kalah ngajeni cara ngaworake denyané tapi uga ngatur denyané kanthi bener,' dia njelaske. Taun iki, mereka jual 13 model—8 ing toko lan 5 online. BHPhoto.com ngedahaken 140+ model nganti harga $50,99 nganti $6.500. Amazon jual sekitar 10.000 drone tiap bulan, karo DJI Phantom 2 Vision+ ($1.000) lan Parrot MiniDrone Rolling Spider ($160) minangka penjualan paling populer. Kekhawatiran keselamatan munggah. Ing Oktober, drone sing ngangkut spanduk nyebabke kerusuhan ing lapangan sepak bola ing Belgrade. Ing Desember, drone hampir tabrak pesawat komersil ing bandara Heathrow London. Seorang pria di Oregon ngaku bersalah amarga ngerusak larangan drone ing taman nasional, nyawer drone ing dekat bison lan ing Midway Geyser Basin Yellowstone. Pabrikan besar kaya DJI, Parrot, lan 3D Robotics mbales karo nyedhiyakake fitur keselamatan: batas ketinggian otomatis (dibatasi 400 kaki, jauh di ngisor kapasitas teknis), geofencing kanggo ngadegake drone saka bandara, lan sistem keamanan kanggo mencegah panggunaan sing ora sah. Mereka uga gabung karo FAA lan komunitas pesawat model kanggo nggalakake kampanye keselamatan nasional, kalebu situs web knowbeforeyoufly.com, pamflet keselamatan, lan petunjuk ing saben kotak drone. 'Sanajan droneé cilik, tetep waspada karo lingkunganmu,' ungkap Lisa Ellman, mantan penasihat Gedung Putih. 'Uga jangan nggunakake denyané kanggo ngawasi tetanggamu.'

article_content: New photographs of the late TV presenter Jimmy Savile, surrounded by children from Woodlands Special School in Scarborough, have reignited speculation that his burial site was deliberately chosen to overlook local schools. The images, taken in 1967, show Savile interacting with dozens of pupils at the special needs school — which still stands directly below Woodlands Cemetery, where he was laid to rest. Savile’s grave is positioned at a 45-degree angle, fulfilling his reported final wish to 'see the sea' upon death. This orientation also faces Graham School, a mixed-gender secondary school serving students aged 11 to 16. While no allegations have been made against Savile involving current or former pupils of either school, he has been accused of sexually abusing more than 120 victims over five decades. Just one week earlier, Savile’s £4,000 headstone — bearing the controversial inscription 'It was good while it lasted' — was secretly removed in a nighttime operation carried out by funeral directors. The Savile family, unaware of the timing, had authorized removal out of concern the grave might become a target for vandalism or media frenzy. The stone, measuring six feet wide and four feet tall, will be broken up and disposed of as landfill. Additional archival photos reveal Savile’s daily life in Scarborough: cycling on his Viking bike, jogging at dawn, and spending time with his mother, Agnes — whom he affectionately called 'The Duchess'. In related news, convicted paedophile Gary Glitter was spotted in London for the first time since allegations linking him to Savile resurfaced. It was alleged that Glitter assaulted a 13-year-old girl in Savile’s BBC dressing room in the 1970s, while Savile himself was reportedly groping a 14-year-old in the same space — though this specific claim has not been proven in court. Meanwhile, BBC Radio 2 presenter Mike Harding, dismissed after 15 years hosting a popular folk music program, criticized the network’s decision, comparing it to how other figures accused of serious misconduct were allowed to remain employed. Harding, who grew his audience from 70,000 to 860,000, said he received only a two-minute phone call from controller Bob Shennan with no explanation. He questioned whether his firing was motivated by financial cuts or declining ratings — neither of which applied — and lamented what he called the BBC’s abandonment of specialist programming.

Foto-foto mau, diambil ing taun 1967, nampilake Savile karo puluhan murid ing sekolah khusus iki — sing masi ana langsung ing ngisor Pemakaman Woodlands, tempaté dikubur. Kajaba iku, Gary Glitter, pedofil sing wis divonis, ditèmokake ing London pisanan kalih sawise dugaan sing nyambungake karo Savile muncul. Dituduhake yen Glitter ngerusak gadis umur 13 taun ing ruang ganti Savile ing BBC taun 1970-an, nalika Savile dhewe lagi nggroping gadis umur 14 taun ing ruang sing padha — nanging dugaan khusus iki belum dibuktiakake ing pengadilan. Harding, sing nggawe audiensié naik saka 70.000 nganti 860.000, ngomong dheweke menerima panggilan telepon dua menit saka pengendali Bob Shennan tanpa penjelasan. Dheweke nanyani yen pemecatané didhaptak déning potongan finansial utawa turuné audiensi — keduane ora cocok — lan nyesal apa sing disebuté BBC nyerah saka program spesialis.

article_content: George Ford announced himself on the international stage with a commanding debut at fly-half, guiding England to a convincing 28-9 win over Samoa at Twickenham — their first victory in six matches. Stepping into the role vacated by Owen Farrell, who shifted to inside centre, the 21-year-old was calm under pressure, weaving through Samoa’s aggressive defence with clever footwork and precise kicks that netted him 13 points. His vision unlocked a brilliant try for Mike Brown, and his willingness to absorb punishing tackles without flinching earned admiration from fans and pundits alike. Jonny May added fire to the win with two explosive tries, capitalizing on his blistering pace, while captain Chris Robshaw led by example with relentless work at the breakdown. Though England’s set piece dominated and several forwards delivered solid shifts, not all performances were flawless: Brad Barritt offered little in attack, and Ben Morgan missed a key tackle that let Samoa score. Samoa, led by the ever-tenacious Kahn Fotuali’i, fought hard but lacked the cohesion to threaten England’s lead beyond isolated moments. As the QBE Series heads into its finale against Australia, Ford’s name has firmly entered the conversation for the starting jersey.

Ngganti posisi Owen Farrell, sing alih kana inside centre, bocah 21 taun iki tenang di bawah tekanan, nglungsi nganti ngadeg kana pertahanan agresif Samoa karo langkah-langkah cerdas lan tendangan tepat sing ngasilake 13 poin. Pandangané mbukak gol brilian kanggo Mike Brown, lan kesediaané ngadepi tendangan keras tanpa gentar nembe nyandhang panghargaan saka penonton lan para pakar. Jonny May nambah semangat kana kemenangan karo loro gol eksploratif, mafaatke kecepatan cepeté, nalika kapten Chris Robshaw njalari conto karo kerja keras ing breakdown. Sadurunge set piece Inggris ngungguli lan sawetara forward ngasilake perpindahan padha, ora kabeh kinerjane apik: Brad Barritt kurang aktif neng serangan, lan Ben Morgan kelupaan tackle sing ngasilake Samoa nglakoni gol. Samoa, sing dipimpin déné Kahn Fotuali’i sing selalu tangguh, nglawan kencang nanging kurang koheren kanggo ngancam pimpinan Inggris sawisé momen-momen terpisah. Pas QBE Series bakal ngarah kana finalé lawan Australia, jeneng Ford wis masuk kana perbincangan kanggo posisi starter.

article_content: In the UK, a quiet shift is happening in cosmetic surgery: more women are choosing to move their own fat to enhance their curves than to remove it. According to upcoming data from the British Association of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (BAAPS), fat transfer procedures — where fat is taken from one part of the body and reinjected elsewhere — have now surpassed liposuction for the first time. Last year, 2,641 women underwent fat transfers compared to 2,638 liposuctions. Surgeons say this isn’t primarily about copying Hollywood icons like Jennifer Lopez or Kim Kardashian. While some do ask for fuller buttocks, most patients are seeking subtle, natural improvements — smoothing out hollows in the face, lifting sagging breasts, or tightening loose skin after weight loss. The appeal? Using your own tissue feels safer after scandals involving defective PIP breast implants and questionable fillers like Botox. Thousands had PIP implants removed after they were found to contain industrial-grade silicone that could leak into the body. Consultant surgeon Michael Cadier, BAAPS President-Elect, notes that while fat transfer has existed for decades, modern techniques make it far more precise and reliable. He says most patients aren’t aiming for dramatic changes — just balanced, youthful contours. Meanwhile, BAAPS President Rajiv Grover highlights that even amid economic uncertainty, demand for these procedures is rising — possibly because people want results that last, not temporary fixes. One patient, 66-year-old Paula Andrews from Merseyside, had fat harvested from her abdomen and injected into her cheeks. 'I was nervous,' she admitted, 'but at least it was my own body — not something foreign.' Her story reflects a broader trend: women are prioritizing safety, authenticity, and long-term outcomes over fleeting trends.

article_content: Over the weekend, a massive fire tore through a century-old piano warehouse in Muncie, Indiana — but amid the chaos, something breathtaking emerged. As firefighters sprayed water to contain the blaze, a brilliant rainbow appeared in the mist, creating a surreal and unforgettable scene. The fire, which broke out around 6:43 a.m. Saturday, quickly consumed the 1895-built three-story brick structure, its wooden frame fueling rapid flames that roared like distant explosions. Despite multiple prior fires at the site, none had been this fierce. Fire crews worked nonstop through Sunday and into Monday, dousing lingering hotspots and soaking nearby trees to prevent spread. Battalion Chief Terry Moore said crews haven’t entered the building, fearing collapse — a concern rooted in its deteriorated state since it was declared unsafe in 2011. No one was hurt, and the cause of the fire remains under investigation.

Sakbareng para petugas pemadam kebakaran nyemprotake air kanggo ngendhalekake kobaran, pelangi cemerlang muncul ing kabut, nemokake adegan sing ajaib lan ora kelangan. Kobaran api, sing mbabar ing kira-kira jam 6:43 sasi Sabtu, cepet banget ngilangi struktur bata tiga lantai sing dibangun ing taun 1895, rangka kayune nggawa kobaran cepet sing mberak kaya ledakan jauh. Sawise pirang-pirang kobaran liyane ing lokasi iki, ora ana sing sembada iki. Tim pemadam kebakaran kerja tanpa henti nalika Minggu lan Senin, nyemprotake titik-titik panas sisa lan nyiram pohon-pohon ing ngarep biar ora ngluas. Kepala Batalyon Terry Moore ngomong tim ora njaluk nggawe gedhinge, gumantung ing bahaya runtuh — masalah sing diwenehi amarga kondisi gedhinge wis buruk since ditandhani ora aman ing taun 2011. Ora ana sing luka, lan penyebab kobaran api tetep lagi ditelusuri.

article_content: Michael Wolff, the media commentator known for his sharp critiques and high-profile personal life, may have initiated divorce proceedings against his wife, Alison Anthoine, without notifying her. Court records from the Supreme Court of New York in Manhattan show a sealed case filed by Wolff as the petitioner. Anthoine, however, told Gawker she was unaware of the filing, stating, 'This is the first time I’ve heard of it.' She added that neither she nor Wolff plans to pursue divorce and that they aim to handle their differences calmly. The couple’s marital troubles trace back to 2009, when Wolff’s affair with Victoria Floethe became public. At the time, reports claimed Anthoine had asked Wolff to leave their Upper East Side home. Though media outlets like the New York Post labeled it a 'steamy public affair,' Floethe later clarified in a column for The Spectator that she was merely a junior researcher at Vanity Fair and that Wolff worked remotely — debunking the notion of an office romance. She also rejected the label of 'femme fatale.' Despite the passage of more than a decade, Wolff and Floethe continue to share intimate moments online. Recent Instagram posts show them enjoying breakfast together — one captioned '#Lanvin' by Floethe, and another by Wolff simply reading 'Breakfast.' Their ongoing connection stands in contrast to Anthoine’s stated desire for peaceful resolution — and raises questions about whether the divorce filing reflects a genuine legal step, or perhaps a strategic maneuver amid unresolved personal dynamics.

Catatan pengadilan saka Supreme Court of New York ing Manhattan nemokake kasus sing ditutup sing diajukan dening Wolff minangka pemohon. article_content: A 21-year-old shoplifter, Keighley Harris, has been banned from all major stores in her town after a five-week crime spree. Harris targeted five different retailers, stealing items such as perfume, hairdryers, saucepans, alcohol, and children’s clothing. On one occasion, she hid stolen goods in a wheelchair while pushing a male friend, Christopher Smith, who was pretending to be disabled, around a garden centre. When confronted by staff, she threatened to assault them. In another incident, Harris racially abused a police officer following her arrest at home after a drunken disturbance. She also threw a flowerpot at a relative’s window and threatened to burn down another family member’s house. In January, Harris stole a bottle of whiskey from Tesco; on January 12, she took three hairdryers from Argos; on January 20, she attempted to steal perfume from Asda; and on January 23, she stole saucepans from Homesense. On February 10, she and Smith targeted Bessingham Garden Centre. They selected three items of children’s clothing, which Smith concealed by sitting on them while seated in the wheelchair. On April 4, Harris was issued a CRASBO — a Criminal Behaviour Order banning her from entering two retail parks, two garden centres, and two supermarkets in Warndon. She is also prohibited from using abusive, racist, or threatening language or behavior toward anyone outside her household. She received a 12-month community order, a drug rehabilitation order, a supervision order, and a 12-week nighttime curfew. Breaching the CRASBO could result in up to five years in prison. Meanwhile, Christopher Smith was sentenced to four weeks in jail after admitting to three counts of theft — including stealing a camera from PC World and a TV from Sainsbury’s — as well as one count of attempted theft and commissioning an offense while serving a suspended sentence.

article_content: On the final day of the Test at Headingley, England’s young batsman Joe Root found himself at the center of a heated on-field exchange with Sri Lanka’s players. Under intense pressure from the opposing team — particularly from captain Angelo Mathews — Root endured a series of verbal exchanges and psychological tactics aimed at disrupting his focus. Umpire Billy Bowden stepped in multiple times to physically separate Root and Mathews after heated moments, including one instance where Mathews famously shushed him. Root, despite the hostility, remained composed until he edged a delivery from Nuwan Pradeep, resulting in a 31-run dismissal. Earlier, Sri Lanka legend Mahela Jayawardene had openly acknowledged in a pre-match press conference that England’s batsmen would be targeted mentally as the match neared its conclusion — a strategy that clearly played out. Root also exchanged words with spinner Rangana Herath during the fiery afternoon session. article_content: A team of materials scientists from the Songshan Lake Materials Laboratory, in collaboration with researchers from the China Academy of Space Technology and the Chinese Academy of Sciences, has discovered that billions of years of exposure to cosmic radiation have hardened lunar glass. In their study, published in Science Advances, the team analyzed microscopic samples of lunar regolith collected by China’s Chang’e-5 lunar lander. These samples — each no wider than a human hair — were examined using a transmission electron microscope and subjected to mechanical stress to assess their structural properties. To understand how radiation altered the glass over time, the researchers heated the samples to 650°C for five minutes, simulating a partial melt that restored them to a near-original state. Comparing the rejuvenated glass with its aged form revealed dramatic changes: Young’s modulus, a measure of material stiffness, shifted by as much as 70%, indicating significant hardening due to prolonged radiation exposure. The findings highlight how natural processes on the Moon, operating over eons, have transformed surface materials in ways that surpass human-made glass production — which has existed for only about 4,000 years.

Dalam penelitiané, sing dipublikasi nang jurnal Science Advances, tim iki nganalisis sampel mikroskopis regolit bulan sing dikumpulaké dening wahana Chang’e-5 Tiongkok. Sampel-sampel iki — masing-masing luwih cilik saka rambut manungsa — diteliti nganggo mikroskop elektron transmisi lan diuji tekanan mekanis kanggo ngukur properti strukturalé. Kanggo ngerti carane radiasi ngowahi kaca selama wektu panjang, para peneliti nyetel sampel-sampel iki menyang 650°C selama lima menit, nyimulasikan peleburan sebagian sing ngembalikaké kaca menyang kondisi asliné. Pembandingan antara kaca sing dikembalikaké karo bentuké sing wis tua nemokaké perubahan dramatis: modulus Young, ukuran kekakuan bahan, berubah sawetara 70%, nandhakaké penguatan signifikan akibat paparan radiasi jangka panjang. article_content: (CNN) — The world’s busiest airport is not in New York or London — it’s Atlanta. Whether measured by passenger traffic or aircraft movements, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport leads globally. According to the latest report from Airports Council International, released last year, more than 95 million passengers passed through the airport in 2012. It also recorded the highest number of takeoffs and landings: 930,000 flight movements that same year. With such intense activity, navigating the airspace around Atlanta is a major challenge. Tom Staigle, Delta’s chief pilot — whose primary hub is in Atlanta — compares the airport to 'a congested freeway.' 'On a clear day, we handle 120 aircraft per hour arriving and departing,' he says. 'You have to be on your toes.' The airport has five runways, all constantly in use. Pilots must remain vigilant even while taxiing on the ground. 'You have to be careful to stay on the correct taxiway and never accidentally enter a runway,' says Delta pilot Stuart Kenny. 'One mistake could mean ending up in the wrong place before takeoff.' To illustrate the complexity, Kenny took CNN Business Traveller through a flight simulator. As a plane approaches Atlanta, pilots see multiple runways, dozens of grounded aircraft, and constant movement across the airfield. 'You’ll see planes ahead, others on the north complex, departures at the far end, and taxis moving toward the south runways,' Kenny explains. This requires seamless coordination between pilots and air traffic controllers. 'We’re working hand-in-hand with ATC,' Kenny says. 'You have to track every aircraft and ensure no one intrudes into your airspace.' The result? Nonstop radio traffic. 'The calls are constant — you have to listen carefully,' he adds. But it’s not just about flights. 'Think about the bags, and passengers transferring from all over the world,' Staigle says. 'They almost always arrive on time — and their luggage comes with them. It’s a surprisingly smooth experience.' Still, Atlanta isn’t among the world’s most admired airports. In Skytrax’s 2013 World Airport Awards, it ranked 48th out of 100 — though it was also named one of the most improved. For many pilots, their first landing in Atlanta is unforgettable. 'I was a young copilot — I was sweating buckets,' Kenny recalls. 'As soon as we touched down, I had to run through the checklist and respond to radio calls. There’s no time to enjoy it.' After all, it’s the world’s busiest airport.

'Pada hari cerah, kami menangani 120 pesawat per jam yang tiba dan berangkat,' katanya. 'Kamu harus selalu waspada.' Bandara ini memiliki lima landasan pacu, semuanya terus-menerus digunakan. 'Kamu harus hati-hati agar tetap di jalur taksi yang benar dan tidak secara tidak sengaja masuk ke landasan pacu,' kata pilot Delta Stuart Kenny. article_content: Once hailed as a titan of German football, Uli Hoeness now stands at the center of a major legal storm. The former World Cup-winning player and long-time president of Bayern Munich has been formally charged with tax evasion related to undisclosed funds held in a Swiss account. Authorities allege he failed to declare more than one million euros in income — a violation that could land him behind bars and trigger heavy financial penalties. The investigation, which spanned several months and drew nationwide attention, culminated in charges filed in mid-2013. Though arrested in March, Hoeness was released on a $6.6 million bail and allowed to retain his position at Bayern, a decision made by the club’s board amid ongoing scrutiny. His defense team has been granted a four-week window to respond, with a judge unlikely to rule on whether the case proceeds to trial until after September. Hoeness’ career was nothing short of iconic. As a dynamic forward and midfielder, he helped West Germany win the 1972 European Championship and lifted the 1974 World Cup. At Bayern, he played a pivotal role in securing three straight European Cups between 1974 and 1976. After a career-ending knee injury at age 27, he transitioned into management, eventually succeeding Franz Beckenbauer as president in 2009 — guiding the club from financial hardship into one of Europe’s most dominant and profitable institutions. The timing couldn’t be worse. Just two months before the charges surfaced, Hoeness oversaw Bayern’s unprecedented domestic and European treble — a historic milestone for German football. Now, as new coach Pep Guardiola begins his tenure, the team lost its opening match of the season to Borussia Dortmund, adding to the sense of upheaval. Beyond sports, the case has ignited a firestorm in German politics. With elections looming, opposition leaders have seized on Hoeness’ case to accuse Chancellor Angela Merkel of turning a blind eye to tax avoidance by the rich. Merkel herself publicly expressed disappointment in Hoeness’ actions, underscoring the national discomfort with elite impunity. Despite his achievements, Hoeness’ legacy now hangs in the balance — caught between admiration for what he built and outrage over what he allegedly hid.

Penyelidikan, yang berlangsung beberapa bulan dan menarik perhatian nasional, berakhir dengan dakwaan yang diajukan pada pertengahan 2013. Meski ditangkap pada Maret, Hoeness dibebaskan dengan jaminan sebesar $6,6 juta dan diizinkan tetap mempertahankan posisinya di Bayern, keputusan yang diambil oleh dewan klub di tengah pengawasan berkelanjutan. Di Bayern, ia memainkan peran penting dalam meraih tiga Piala Eropa berturut-turut antara 1974 dan 1976. Setelah cedera lutut yang mengakhiri karirnya di usia 27 tahun, ia beralih ke manajemen, dan akhirnya menggantikan Franz Beckenbauer sebagai presiden pada 2009 — membimbing klub dari kesulitan keuangan menjadi salah satu institusi paling dominan dan menguntungkan di Eropa. Waktunya tak bisa lebih buruk. Dua bulan sebelum dakwaan muncul, Hoeness mengawasi pencapaian tanpa preseden Bayern: treble domestik dan Eropa — tonggak sejarah bagi sepak bola Jerman. Kini, saat pelatih baru Pep Guardiola memulai masa jabatannya, tim kalah dalam laga pembuka musim melawan Borussia Dortmund, menambah rasa kekacauan. Di luar olahraga, kasus ini memicu badai politik di Jerman. Dengan pemilu yang segera datang, para oposisi menyalahkan Kanselir Angela Merkel karena mengabaikan penghindaran pajak oleh kaum kaya. Merkel sendiri secara terbuka menyatakan kekecewaannya atas tindakan Hoeness, menegaskan ketidaknyamanan nasional terhadap kekebalan elit. Meski memiliki prestasi luar biasa, warisan Hoeness kini bergantung pada keseimbangan antara kekaguman atas apa yang ia bangun dan kemarahan atas apa yang ia sembunyikan.
